name: mcpgawk
description: One checkpoint between your agent and its MCP servers: a tool that changed after you approved it is refused until you decide. Your inventory stays on your machine.

interface.shortDescription: Be told when an MCP server changes after you approved it, before your agent calls it.
interface.longDescription: mcpgawk checks the MCP servers your agent can reach, records the tool surface you approved, reports any change after that, and with the guard installed refuses a changed tool before the call runs. mcpgawk refuses an approval when it can see an agent running it. Your inventory stays on your machine.
defaultPrompt: Check what this MCP server can do before I add it.
What can my MCP servers do and what do they cost?
Did any of my MCP servers change since I approved them?
